editorial.name: Workday/canvas-kit
editorial.descriptionZh: 照着 Workday Canvas Design System（canvas.workday.com）实现 UI 的开发套件，仓库是 lerna 管理的多包结构；README 把 Getting Started、Versioning、Version Support、Supported Browsers 逐条写开，另有一份 STYLE.md 定下圆角与 parts 命名约定。
editorial.takeawayZh: 照 Canvas 设计系统铺组件，命名看 STYLE.md
editorial.noteZh: 右栏 About 写 Development kits to implement UI following the Workday Canvas Design System，外链 workday.github.io/canvas-kit/，挂 design-system 与 workday 两个 topic，标 Apache-2.0 license，875 Releases、最新 v16.1.0、Used by 110。文件树里 modules、cypress、.storybook、skills、test-utils、utils 几块并排，根目录有 STYLE.md、CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md、lerna.json、styling.config.ts 和 doc.config.json，STYLE.md 那条提交信息是 docs: Add corner shape and parts conventions to STYLE.md。

reasons.statement: 仓库定位就是某个设计系统的落地实现套件（About 自述 Development kits to implement UI following the Workday Canvas Design System），还配了 STYLE.md 与 Version Support、Versioning 等治理章节，符合设计系统与完整组件套件这一小类。
